prize_name: Albert Einstein World Award of Science
funding_share_basis: The purse is a single Award Cheque (USD 10,000) paid by the World Cultural Council itself; no external donor, endowment, or corporate sponsor of the purse is disclosed on the WCC site or in any award announcement we found, so the WCC supplies 100% of it in both states. The same body has paid throughout since 1984 — the only change is the seat: the WCC was founded in Mexico in 1982 (first ceremony Monterrey 1984; secondary sources still list Mexico City) while its only currently published address is Case Postale 373, 1630 Bulle 2, Switzerland, hence origin country Mexico and current country Switzerland. Host universities underwrite the annual ceremony locally, but that is event cost, not purse. [funder_changed set to false on review: the World Cultural Council has paid the purse throughout; only its registered seat moved from Mexico to Switzerland, which is a relocation, not a handover of funding.]
money_note: Diploma, commemorative medal and an Award Cheque of USD 10,000, paid by the World Cultural Council out of its own funds; the amount has been reported at USD 10,000 in recent cycles and no funder change is documented.
evidence_quote: The prize consists of a diploma, a commemorative medal and an Award Cheque. ... World Cultural Council, Case Postale 373, 1630 Bulle 2, Switzerland
judgment_reason: Three calls. (1) Seat: the WCC's official site says it was 'founded in Mexico in 1982' but publishes only a Swiss address (Bulle, canton Fribourg) and describes itself as administered from there, while Wikipedia/Wikidata still list Mexico City and no current Mexican address exists anywhere we could find; we coded the awarding org as Switzerland (current registered seat) and the origin funder as Mexico. Wayback captures that would date the move were unreachable, so Mexico for both states is the defensible alternative. (2) funder_changed is true only because of that seat relocation — the same organization has paid the purse throughout, with no handover to a new funder. (3) Type: the WCC is an INGO whose membership is individual academics from ~60 countries, coded Society (membership organization of scholars); International is the alternative, but it is neither a treaty body nor a federation of national organizations.
